STATUTE I.
CHAP. XXVII.—An Act to alter the Time for the next Meeting of Congress.
[Expired.]
SECTION 1. Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives
of the United States of America in Congress assembled, That after the
adjournment of the present session, the next meeting of Congress shall
be on the first Monday in January next.
APPROVED, September 29, 1789.

June the sixth, one thousand seven hundred and eighty-eight, be made
and returned to the Secretary of the Treasury without delay; and that
the President of the United States be requested to appoint a fit person
to complete the same, who shall be allowed five dollars per day whilst
actually employed in the said service, with the expenses necessarily at-
tending the execution thereof.
APPROVED, August 26, 1789.
